title: HPLC Picking
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create worklist file
steps.instruction:
Prepare a CSV worklist with columns source,dest,volume and list each transfer; for example:
source,dest,volume
1,A1,300
2,A1,300
3,A1,300
4,A1,300
10,B1,300
12,B1,300
13,B1,300
14,B1,300

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware files
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select any required labware definition files with a .json extension.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App Protocol tab, upload the protocol file that has a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT App calibration routine to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the HPLC picking protocol.
